[[File:Krayt_Pearl.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Krayt dragon pearl]]
'''Krayt dragon pearls''' were lustrous, colored stones found in the last chamber of the gizzard of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]]. The stones were used to help crush food eaten by them, and over time, they became rounded because of how much they moved around. They could be found in colors such as blue, green, red, white and black. Due to a refractive quality peculiar to the pearl, they could be used in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] if properly cleaned, prepared and installed, though it was a difficult task. The pearls were seen as exceptionally valuable by the public (easily worth upwards of a hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each), as well as proof a person had killed a krayt dragon (to [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], a sign of bravery).

Both the [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|Common]] and [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|Greater Krayt Dragons]] produced pearls, however the pearls of the Greater Krayt were much larger and correspondingly much more valuable.

==History==
[[File:TuskenKraytPearl-SWG4.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Tusken Raider claims a pearl from a greater krayt dragon]]
An illustrious owner of one of these famous pearls was [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who got it in exchange for helping [[Komad Fortuna]] kill an enormous canyon krayt that was nesting inside a cave near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Revan either gave it to the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], who recognized him as a warrior and allowed him to learn their tradition, or kept it for his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], or sold it for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

[[Calo Nord]] intended to acquire a Krayt Dragon pearl on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but, due to the Sith quarantine of Taris, he was forced to stay and work for Davik. The pearls were also sought by [[Bastila Shan]]'s [[Bastila Shan's father|father]], who planned on using the credits to treat his [[Helena Shan|wife's]] terminal illness. Unfortunately, Mr. Shan was killed at the [[Dune Sea krayt dragon|krayt's]] claws, leaving only his [[Datacron/Legends|data holocron]] behind.

[["Shady" Pers]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], received a krayt pearl the size of a human head from a delivery from Tatooine. Although it could easily bring him a hundred thousand credits, the pearl was soon confiscated from Pers by an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

The hunter [[Doallyn/Legends|Doallyn]] retrieved five pearls from a krayt dragon he killed while escorting [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] across the Tatooine desert after the death of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

[[Bly/Legends|CC-5052 "Bly"]] wielded two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 pistols]] whose handles were made of krayt dragon pearls.

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used a krayt dragon pearl to pay his way into the famous [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game where he won the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
